name: ado-stacked-pullrequests
description: Azure DevOps extension that shows stacked pull requests as a hierarchy and lets you review only the part each branch introduced.

scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs azure-devops-extension.json --output-path dist-vsix
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && node scripts/dev-manifest.js && tfx extension create --manifest-globs azure-devops-extension.dev.generated.json --output-path dist-vsix
